checks.name: gui-local-refinement-add
checks.detail: Reference demo with 6 selected triangles, base size 4 mm: #local-mesh-add (size 2, radius 10) registered 6 refinements (one per selected triangle, first {center:[10,6.67,26.67],size:2,radius:10}); selection kept at 6 triangles; status message shown.

checks.name: gui-local-refinement-invalid-size-refused
checks.detail: Local size 8 (200% of base) refused with 'Local size must be 15–100% of baseSize'; refinement count stayed 6.

checks.name: connector-previewEdit-edit-addSelectedMeshRefinements
checks.detail: previewEdit and edit with {size:1,radius:10,baseSize:4} returned the same resulting revision; page state then had 12 refinements, selection and condition count unchanged; a repeated edit with the old revision was refused ('Project revision conflict').

checks.name: meshBoundaryPreflight-defect-found
checks.detail: On the unfixed code the live meshBoundaryPreflight refused a successful settled mesh-only job of the GUI demo with ANALYSIS_MESH_PREFLIGHT_MODEL_UNSUPPORTED (limited to static linear structural inputs, kind structural). Cause: the GUI always exports study.materialTemperature (default 20) and the check treated any defined value as unsupported; unit tests used minimal fixtures and missed it.

checks.name: meshBoundaryPreflight-after-fix
checks.detail: After the fix (materialTemperature is relevant only with a material temperature dependence), the same flow returned allowed:true, completePreflight:false, reports for condition 0 (fixed, original 100 mm2, mapped 100 mm2, relative error 0) and condition 1 (force, 100 mm2 → 100 mm2, error 0), diagnostics []. A request with a wrong input revision returned ANALYSIS_MESH_PREFLIGHT_STALE_INPUT, an unknown jobId was refused, and the live input revision was unchanged afterwards.

regressionTest: tests/mesh-boundary-preflight.test.mjs 'GUI-style input with the default materialTemperature is inspected; a temperature-dependent material is still refused' fails on the previous code and passes after the fix.
notVerified: Published HTTPS site and connection from it (PUBLICHTTPS1).

Real CAD (STEP) inputs and non-box geometry were not exercised; only the built-in axial-bar demo.
